# Angëlo — Visual Practice

Independent graphic design and visual communication by Angëlo (Faith Akinola Boyejo), Lagos, Nigeria.

Portfolio: https://designsbyangelo.netlify.app/
Selected work: 10 case studies across identity, editorial, campaigns, packaging and digital design.
Visual studies: 20 exploratory compositions.
Contact: faithakinaboyejo@gmail.com
Concepts are labelled as self-initiated where applicable. No client outcomes or testimonials are invented.
